usage: AI App Bridge supports Android native apps; Android WebView/H5/CDP; Flutter apps on Android and iOS; iOS native apps via AiAppBridgeIOS + WebDriverAgent/XCUITest; WKWebView; desktop Web Bridge sessions. MCP has two tools: call capabilities to discover domains, commands, and options, then call run with the selected command and arguments. Use run with one of these command names. Prefer packageName for Android app commands, bundleId/deviceId for iOS, and sessionId/targetId for Web Bridge sessions.
